title: All demons eulogising their strengths
introduction: All the demons of King Ravana present there namely Prahasta, Durmukha, Vajradamshtra, Nikumbha and Vajrahanu, eulogising their strengths, assure the king that they can individually kill Rama and his army within no time.
closing: Thus completes 8th Chapter of Yuddha Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
ततो नील अम्बुद निभः प्रहस्तो नाम राक्षसः |
अब्रवीत् प्राञ्जलिर् वाक्यम् शूरः सेना पतिस्तदा
verses.iast:
tato nīla ambuda nibhaḥ prahasto nāma rākṣasaḥ |
abravīt prāJṇjalir vākyam śūraḥ senā patistadā
verses.translation: A valiant demon by name Prahasta, the commander-in-chief, appearing like a dark cloud, joined his palms in salutation and spoke these words.

verses.devanagari:
देव दानव गन्धर्वाः पिशाचपतगौरगाः |
न त्वाम् धर्षयितुम् शक्ताः किम् पुनर् वानरा रणे
verses.iast:
deva dānava gandharvāḥ piśācapatagauragāḥ |
na tvām dharṣayitum śaktāḥ kim punar vānarā raṇe
verses.translation: "All gods, demons, gandharvas, devils, birds and serpents can be attacked by you in battle. Why to talk about two human beings?"

verses.devanagari:
सर्वे प्रमत्ता विश्वस्ता वन्चिताः स्म हनूमता |
न हि मे जीवतो गच्चेज् जीवन् स वन गोचरः
verses.iast:
sarve pramattā viśvastā vancitāḥ sma hanūmatā |
na hi me jīvato gaccej jīvan sa vana gocaraḥ
verses.translation: "All of us, in good faith but with negligence, were cheated by Hanuma. That monkey cannot go alive, while I am alive."

verses.devanagari:
सर्वाम् सागर पर्यन्ताम् सशैल वन काननाम् |
करोमि अवानराम् भूमिम् आज्ञापयतु माम् भवान्
verses.iast:
sarvām sāgara paryantām saśaila vana kānanām |
karomi avānarām bhūmim āGYāpayatu mām bhavān
verses.translation: "I shall make the entire earth extending upto the ocean, along with mountains forests and woods, bereft of monkeys. You command me."

glosses.meaning: along with mountains forests and woods

verses.devanagari:
रक्षाम् चैव विधास्यामि वानराद् रजनी चर |
न आगमिष्यति ते दुह्खम् किंचिद् आत्म अपराधजम्
verses.iast:
rakṣām caiva vidhāsyāmi vānarād rajanī cara |
na āgamiṣyati te duhkham kiṃcid ātma aparādhajam
verses.translation: "Oh, Ravana! I shall arrange for your defence from that monkey. Not a little trouble will come to you on account of your guilt (abduction of Seetha)."

glosses.meaning: on account of your guilt (abduction of Seetha).

verses.devanagari:
अब्रवीत्तम् सुसम्क्रुद्धो दुर्मुखो नाम राक्षसः |
इदम् न क्षमणीयम् हि सर्वेषाम् नः प्रधर्षणम्
verses.iast:
abravīttam susamkruddho durmukho nāma rākṣasaḥ |
idam na kṣamaṇīyam hi sarveṣām naḥ pradharṣaṇam
verses.translation: A demon by name Durmukha, being seriously enraged, spoke to him as follows: "This humiliation meted out to us by that monkey is indeed not to be tolerated."

glosses.meaning: is indeed not to be tolerated.

verses.devanagari:
अयम् परिभवो भूयः पुरस्य अन्तः पुरस्य च |
श्रीमतो राक्षस इन्द्रस्य वानर इन्द्र प्रधर्षणम्
verses.iast:
ayam paribhavo bhūyaḥ purasya antaḥ purasya ca |
śrīmato rākṣasa indrasya vānara indra pradharṣaṇam
verses.translation: "This insult to the city of Lanka and the palaces together with attack by Sugreeva on the glorious Ravana are still outrageous."

verses.devanagari:
अस्मिन् मुहूर्ते हत्वा एको निवर्तिष्यामि वानरान् |
प्रविष्टान् सागरम् भीमम् अम्बरम् वा रसा तलम्
verses.iast:
asmin muhūrte hatvā eko nivartiṣyāmi vānarān |
praviṣṭān sāgaram bhīmam ambaram vā rasā talam
verses.translation: "Proceeding at this moment alone, I shall destroy those monkeys, whether they entered the ocean or the subterranean region or the sky."

glosses.meaning: or into the terrific subterranean region under the earth

verses.devanagari:
ततो अब्रवीत् सुसम्क्रुद्धो वज्र दम्ष्ट्रो महाबलः |
प्रगृह्य परिघम् घोरम् मांस शोणित रूपितम्
verses.iast:
tato abravīt susamkruddho vajra damṣṭro mahābalaḥ |
pragṛhya parigham ghoram māṃsa śoṇita rūpitam
verses.translation: Thereafter the very strong Vajradamshtra, beset with great anger, took hold of a terrific iron club smeared with flesh and blood and spoke (as follows):

verses.devanagari:
किम् नो हनुमता कार्यम् कृपणेन तपस्विना |
रामे तिष्ठति दुर्धर्षे सुग्रीवे सह लक्ष्मणे
verses.iast:
kim no hanumatā kāryam kṛpaṇena tapasvinā |
rāme tiṣṭhati durdharṣe sugrīve saha lakṣmaṇe
verses.translation: "What work for us with that pitiable and miserable Hanuma, when Rama along with Lakshmana and Sugreeva who are difficult to be conquered exist?"

glosses.meaning: who are difficult to be conquered

verses.devanagari:
अद्य रामम् ससुग्रीवम् परिघेण सलक्ष्मणम् |
आगमिष्यामि हत्वा एको विक्षोभ्य हरि वाहिनीम्
verses.iast:
adya rāmam sasugrīvam parigheṇa salakṣmaṇam |
āgamiṣyāmi hatvā eko vikṣobhya hari vāhinīm
verses.translation: "Now itself, with this iron club, killing Rama, Lakshmana and Sugreeva after perturbing the army of monkeys, I shall come back."

verses.devanagari:
इदम् ममापरम् वाक्यम् शृणु राजन्यदीच्चसि |
उपायकुशलो ह्येव जयेच्चत्रुनतन्द्रितः
verses.iast:
idam mamāparam vākyam śṛṇu rājanyadīccasi |
upāyakuśalo hyeva jayeccatrunatandritaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, king! If you are willing, hear my words further. One who is skilled din a stratagem alone will be without lassitude and can indeed defeat the enemies."

glosses.meaning: one who is skilled in stratagem only

verses.devanagari:
कामरूपधराः शूराः सुभीमा भीमदर्शनाः |
राक्षसा वा सहस्राणि राक्षसाधिप निश्चिताः
काकुत्थ्समुपसम्गम्य बिभ्रतो मानुषम् वपुः |
सर्वे ह्यसम्भ्रमा भूत्वा ब्रुवन्तु रघुसत्तमम्
verses.iast:
kāmarūpadharāḥ śūrāḥ subhīmā bhīmadarśanāḥ |
rākśasā vā sahasrāṇi rākśasādhipa niścitāḥ
kākutthsamupasamgamya bibhrato mānuṣam vapuḥ |
sarve hyasambhramā bhūtvā bruvantu raghusattamam
verses.translation: O, king of demons! Thousands of demons able to change their form at will courageaous appalling terrifying to look at and firm (in their purpose) can wear human body approach Rama without embarrassment and all speak to Rama (as follows).

glosses.meaning: able to change their form at will

verses.devanagari:
प्रेषिता भरतेनैव भ्रात्रा तव यवीयसा |
स हि सेनाम् समुत्थाप्य क्षिप्रमेवोपयास्यति
verses.iast:
preṣitā bharatenaiva bhrātrā tava yavīyasā |
sa hi senām samutthāpya kśipramevopayāsyati
verses.translation: "We have been despatched by Bharata, your younger brother. He is summoning his forces and will surely come here soon."

verses.devanagari:
ततो वयमितस्तुर्णम् शूलशक्तिगदाधराः |
चापबाणासिहस्तश्च त्वरितास्तत्र यामहे
verses.iast:
tato vayamitasturṇam śūlaśaktigadādharāḥ |
cāpabāṇāsihastaśca tvaritāstatra yāmahe
verses.translation: "Carrying spikes, javelins and maces together with arrows and swords in hand, we will quickly go there from here soon."

glosses.meaning: with arrows and swords in hand

verses.devanagari:
आकाशे गणशः स्थित्वा हत्वा ताम् हरिवाहिनीम् |
अश्मशस्त्रमहावृष्ट्वा प्रापयाम् यमक्षयम्
verses.iast:
ākāśe gaṇaśaḥ sthitvā hatvā tām harivāhinīm |
aśmaśastramahāvṛṣṭvā prāpayām yamakśayam
verses.translation: "Standing as groups in the sky and beating that army of monkeys with a mighty hail of stones and missiles, we should send them to the world of Death."

glosses.meaning: with a mighty hail of stones and missiles
we should send 9them) yamakshayam = to the world of Death.

verses.devanagari:
एवम् चेदुपसर्पेतामनयम् रामलक्ष्मणौ |
अवश्यमपनीतेन जहतामेव जीवितम्
verses.iast:
evam cedupasarpetāmanayam rāmalakśmaṇau |
avaśyamapanītena jahatāmeva jīvitam
verses.translation: "If Rama and Lakshmana thus approach softly into our trap they will surely abandon their lives as they are taken away by the trap."

glosses.meaning: as they are taken away (by the trap)

verses.devanagari:
कौम्भकर्णिस् ततो वीरो निकुम्भो नाम वीर्यवान् |
अब्रवीत् परम कुर्द्धो रावणम् लोक रावणम्
verses.iast:
kaumbhakarṇis tato vīro nikumbho nāma vīryavān |
abravīt parama kurddho rāvaṇam loka rāvaṇam
verses.translation: Thereafter Kumbhakarna's son, by name Nikumbha, strong and powerful, became very angry and spoke (as follows) to Ravana, who made people cry.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वे भवन्तस् तिष्ठन्तु महाराजेन सम्गताः |
अहम् एको हनिष्यामि राघवम् सह लक्ष्मणम्
सुग्रीवम् सहनूमन्तम् सर्वांश्चैवात्र वानरान् |
verses.iast:
sarve bhavantas tiṣṭhantu mahārājena samgatāḥ |
aham eko haniṣyāmi rāghavam saha lakṣmaṇam
sugrīvam sahanūmantam sarvāṃścaivātra vānarān |
verses.translation: All of you stay along with the king. I alone will kill there, Rama along with Lakshman, Sugreeva along with Hanuma and all the monkeys also.

verses.devanagari:
ततो वज्रहनुर्नाम राक्षसः पर्वतोपमः
क्रुद्धः परिलिहन् वक्त्रम् जिह्वया वाक्यम् अब्रवीत् |
verses.iast:
tato vajrahanurnāma rākśasaḥ parvatopamaḥ
kruddhaḥ parilihan vaktram jihvayā vākyam abravīt |
verses.translation: Then, a demon by name Vajrahanu who was resembling a mountain, becoming enraged and licking the corners of his mouth with his tongue, spoke as follows:

verses.devanagari:
स्वैरम् कुर्वन्तु कार्याणि भवन्तो विगत ज्वराः
एको अहम् भक्षयिष्यामि तान् सर्वान् हरि यूथपान् |
स्वस्थाः क्रीडन्तु निश्चिन्ताः पिबन्तु मधु वारुणीम्
verses.iast:
svairam kurvantu kāryāṇi bhavanto vigata jvarāḥ
eko aham bhakṣayiṣyāmi tān sarvān hari yūthapān |
svasthāḥ krīḍantu niścintāḥ pibantu madhu vāruṇīm
verses.translation: "You do your occupations freely redeemed of mental pain, play comfortably and drink spirituous liquor without any worry. I alone will devour the entire army of monkeys."

verses.devanagari:
अहम् एको हनिष्यामि सुग्रीवम् सह लक्ष्मणम् |
स अन्गदम् च हनूमन्तम् रामम् च रण कुन्जरम्
verses.iast:
aham eko haniṣyāmi sugrīvam saha lakṣmaṇam |
sa angadam ca hanūmantam rāmam ca raṇa kunjaram
verses.translation: At this time I alone will kill Sugreeva along with Lakshmana Hanuma along with Angada and all monkeys.
